description:
Official open-science data and reproducible Python 3.13 / R 4.6.2 analytical compendium accompanying Diab AA, Seddek MN (2026): Subunit and multi-epitope vaccines against carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii: a systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO Registration: CRD420261572661).

Contents (Version 4.0.0 — Full-Text-Verified Synthesis across n = 55 Unique Peer-Reviewed Publications):

  • Track 1 Preclinical Murine Challenge Meta-Analysis (k = 22 independent experiments from 20 publications, 48 active arms, 30 platform units, N = 574 mice): Track1_22_experiments_verified.csv, Track1_48_arms_verified.csv, Track1_30_platform_units_verified.csv, Track1_20_leave_one_out_verified.csv, Track1_20_SYRCLE_verified.csv, and Table_S2_77_excluded_studies_verified.csv (71.8% [280/390] vaccinated vs. 7.1% [13/184] control survival; DerSimonian–Laird RR = 3.69 [HKSJ 95% CI: 2.56–5.33, p < 0.0001, I² = 0.0%]; additive RD = +62.6 percentage points [HKSJ 95% CI: 53.5–71.8, 95% PI: +29.3 to +96.0, I²_RD = 57.6%]).
  • Track 2 Methodological Quality Audit of In Silico MEVC Pipelines (k = 22 studies, 2018–2026): Track2_22_insilico_rubric_verified.csv (verified mean 4.91 ± 2.00 / 14, median 5.0, range 2–8).
  • Track 3 Egyptian & MENA Clinical Molecular Epidemiology (k = 17 cohorts, 1,724 analyzed isolates/episodes): Track3_17_cohorts_verified.csv (90.7% [500/551] carbapenem resistance across strictly unselected Egyptian cohorts; 1.2%–52.9% reference ISO 20776-1 broth microdilution colistin resistance).
  • Reproducible Code, Figures & Checklists: meta_analysis_results.json, compute_track1_exact.py, generate_figures_in_R.R, consolidate_and_generate_figures.py, 600-DPI publication figures, PRISMA_2020_CHECKLIST.md, Table_S1_PICOS_Framework.md, and Supplementary_Material_Checklist_S1_Tables_S1_S2.pdf.
